children: Italy’s current account surplus narrowed to EUR 7,384.1 million in July 2026 from EUR 7,846.8 million in the corresponding month of the previous year.
The services surplus narrowed to EUR 1,102.9 million from EUR 1,313.2 million last year, while the primary income balance swung to a deficit of EUR 116.0 million from a surplus of EUR 412.1 million.
At the same time, the secondary income deficit widened to EUR 1,791.3 million from EUR 1,697.7 million.
These were offset by a wider goods surplus, increasing to EUR 8,188.6 million from EUR 7,819.2 million.

title: Italy Current Account Surplus Narrows in July
